# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. Native Windows build and process checks contribute to the CI `all checks passed` verdict; Wine runs Windows Node on hosted Linux only in `ci-master.yml`. The CI workflow selects Linux/Windows x64 Python runtime targets, and CI master selects Linux ARM64 plus both macOS architectures; releases retain all five targets ([platform policy](workflows/ci-master.yml)). Only `deploy-image.yml` automatically runs on master pushes. All other workflows require `workflow_dispatch`; reusable builders also retain `workflow_call` for manually started callers. Event-dependent jobs retain their payload requirements. Master-only platform checks, Linux/Windows self-hosted standbys, and manual runner benchmarks live in `ci-master.yml`, which uses `workflow_dispatch`; separating workflow triggers keeps master-only jobs out of PR check panels. The master standbys validate the self-hosted failover targets; preserve the existing per-platform switches (values `selfhosted` for the in-house standbys and `blacksmith` for Blacksmith's hosted runners) and the Dependabot hosted fallback under the `selfhosted` values ([failover runbook](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-07-26-ci-failover-runbook.md), [blacksmith failover leg note](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-09-blacksmith-failover-leg.md)).

The manual [Windows packaging workflow](workflows/windows-package.yml) uses the dedicated self-hosted Windows x64 label `dsh-win-package-trial` under native `pwsh`; preserve this routing separately from the general CI lanes.
